basic_info.description: Enjoy panoramic views from this expansive 3,200 square foot half floor apartment with a large Bay View balcony. There are unobstructed views from the Golden Gate Bridge, North Bay, Angel Island, Alcatraz and some Financial District. The direct access elevator opens into a spacious Bay View foyer with wet bar and wine cooler. Apartment #9E has been completely renovated including opening up the floor plan, installing all new windows, all new kitchen with a 6-burner gas stove, all new bathrooms, a new large laundry room, new wood floors throughout and recessed lighting. Building amenities include 24-hour doorman, Gym, 1 parking space and extra storage. It's a short walk to Fillmore Street and Union Street shopping and dining.
